name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Glute Bridge
description: Unilateral bridge correcting glute imbalances with added resistance.
setup: Lie on back, one foot flat, other leg extended, dumbbell on working hip.
execution: Drive hips up through working leg, squeeze glute, lower with control.
breathing: Exhale on drive, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Frog Pump
description: Supine hip abduction with glute squeeze targeting outer glutes.
setup: Lie on back, soles of feet together, knees out, dumbbell on hips.
execution: Drive hips up squeezing glutes, hold 1-2 seconds, lower.
breathing: Exhale on up, inhale on lower

name: Standing Dumbbell Glute Kickback
description: Standing rear kick isolating the glute max through hip extension.
setup: Stand holding onto support, dumbbell behind one knee held by calf.
execution: Kick leg back squeezing glute, hold 1 second, return to start.
breathing: Exhale on kick, inhale on return
progression: Heavier weight or band around knees

name: Reverse Dumbbell Step-Up
description: Stepping backward onto platform targeting glutes and hamstrings.
setup: Stand facing away from bench, dumbbells in hands.
execution: Step one foot back onto bench, drive through front heel to stand.
breathing: Inhale on step, exhale on drive

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Squat to Bench
description: Assisted single-leg squat building extreme quad and glute strength.
setup: Stand on one leg in front of bench, dumbbell at chest or one in each hand.
execution: Lower to bench on one leg, pause briefly, drive back up on same leg.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on drive
progression: Deficit or no pause on bench
